Service Schedule and Preventive Maintenance i. Routine Servicing: Preventive maintenance visits shall be conducted at least once ev ery month to inspect system performance, check electrical components, TDS Monitorin

g and flush filters etc. ii. Comprehensive Cleaning & Sanitizing: Deep cleaning, chemical dosing, storage tank sterilization, and replacement of consumable sediment/carbon candles shall be carried out at least once every six months. iii. Breakdown / Emergency Visits: In case of sudden breakdown, leakage, electrical fail ure, or alarming TDS/water quality fluctuation, the vendor shall attend to the service c all within 24 hours of lodging the complaint. iv. In case of delay beyond stipulated time, penalty may be imposed by the department as under: a. ₹300 per day per machine shall be deducted for non-attendance of complaints beyond stipulated response time. b. If any machine remains non-functional for more than 07 days continuously, proportionate AMC charges shall be deducted. c. Repeated failure to provide satisfactory services may lead to termination of contract and forfeitu re of Performance Security. 4. Mandatory Vendor Qualifications and Documentation Requirements The participating vendor must submit the following statutory and operational documents along wit h their bid: i. ISO Certification: Valid ISO: 9001 quality management or relevant industry certification to ensure standardized service delivery. ii. Business Registration Certificate: Proof of legal establishment, incorporation, or trade licen se, possess valid GST registration, Submit PAN and relevant documents as required on GeM. iii. Experience certificate: Verified documentary evidence demonstrating at least 2 years of r elevant industry experience in performing similar maintenance or servicing. iv. Must have local service support for prompt attendance at consignee location. v. The bidder must comply with all applicable GeM guidelines, Government procurement rules, lab our laws, GST provisions and safety regulations. vi. All bidder to upload ATC certificate along with bid number on company letter head. 5.1 Maintenance Reports: Signed and dated service logs detailing all completed checks, compo nent replacements, and past histories. 5.2 Material safety data sheet: Official safety sheets for any cleaning chemical, sterilizing age nts or consumables utilized during the maintenance process. 6. Warranty Period: A minimum warranty period of at least 6 months is required for all equip ment repaired, serviced, and replaced. 7.1 Security Deposit / Performance Security. The successful bidder shall deposit a Performanc e Security/Security Deposit equivalent to 2 % of the contract value within 07 days of award of contract. 7.2 The Performance Security may be submitted in the form of :- Bank Guarantee, Fixed De posit Receipt (FDR), Insurance Surety Bond or any form permitted under GeM/Government rules. 7.3 The Security Deposit shall remain valid for the entire AMC period plus an additional 30 days aft er completion of contract. 7.4 No interest shall be payable on the Security Deposit. The Security Deposit may be forfeited par tially or fully in case of failure to provide services as per contract, repeated delays in attending co mplaints, use of substandard spare parts/material & Breach of contract terms. 7.5 The Security Deposit shall be released after satisfactory completion of the AMC and clearance of all dues/liabilities.

8. Genuine Spares & Replacements: All replacement components (including RO membranes, fi lters, pumps, valves and other electrical equipment) must be 100% genuine, brand new, and fully compatible with the installed models. Second-hand or refurbished parts are strictly prohibited. 9. Statutory & Compliance Obligations: The selected vendor shall comply with safety regulati ons for their deployed service personnel. The buyer shall bear no liability for accidents or injuries t o technician staff during service operations. 10. Payment Terms: Payments shall be released on a quarterly basis upon successful complet ion of scheduled maintenance visits, submission of satisfactory service reports, and necessary pre /post-service documentation countersigned by the designated office authority. Deduction of applic able taxes if any shall be made as per Government rules. 11. Performance Security / Penalty Clause: Non-compliance with response times, delayed rep airs, or failure to maintain water quality standards shall result in deduction from pending bills or fo rfeiture of security deposits and penalty charges will be deducted as per penalty clause of Gem Portal. 12. Buyer Office Details: Office of the Controller of Communication Accounts, UP (West) Circle, Brahmpuri Telecom Building, Delhi Road, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh – 250002 13. Termination: The Department reserves the right to terminate the contract at any time by givi ng 30 days' notice in case of unsatisfactory performance, breach of contract conditions or non-co mpliance with instructions. .
